title: Irregular Past Participles - Set 2 (wanted, could, had to, said)
description: Learn modal verbs and -RE verbs in past tense: vouloir → voulu (wanted), pouvoir → pu (could), devoir → dû (had to), dire → dit (said), prendre → pris (took)
can_do: Express past desires, abilities, and obligations (wanted, could, had to)
Say 'I wanted to go', 'I could come', 'I had to work'
Use irregular past forms for modal and -RE verbs

vocabulary.gloss: I could / I was able to
I had to / I must have

concepts.definition: vouloir → voulu, pouvoir → pu, devoir → dû (all end in -u)
concepts.example: {J'ai voulu partir} (I wanted to leave), {J'ai pu venir} (I could come), {J'ai dû travailler} (I had to work)

concepts.definition: Irregular past participle: j'ai dit, tu as dit, il a dit
concepts.example: {J'ai dit oui} (I said yes), {Tu as dit non} (You said no)
{J'ai pris le bus} (I took the bus), {J'ai compris} (I understood), {J'ai appris le français} (I learned French)

concepts.definition: Irregular past participle: j'ai mis, tu as mis, il a mis
concepts.example: {J'ai mis mon manteau} (I put on my coat), {J'ai mis ça là} (I put that there)

concepts.definition: Modal verbs can be followed by infinitives in past tense
concepts.example: {J'ai voulu aller} (I wanted to go), {J'ai pu venir} (I was able to come), {J'ai dû partir} (I had to leave)

concepts.definition: All these verbs use '{avoir}' (not être) in passé composé
concepts.example: {j'ai voulu}, {j'ai pu}, {j'ai dû}, {j'ai dit}, {j'ai pris}, {j'ai mis}

items.text: J'___ partir mais je n'ai pas pu
items.gloss: I wanted to leave but I couldn't

mistakes.feedback: The past participle of vouloir is '{voulu}': j'ai voulu.
That's imparfait! Use passé composé: j'ai voulu (I wanted).
'Pu' is for pouvoir (could)! Use '{voulu}' for vouloir (wanted).

items.gloss: Could you come? / Were you able to come?

mistakes.feedback: The past participle of pouvoir is '{pu}': tu as pu.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: tu as pu (you could).
That's imparfait! Use passé composé: tu as pu (you were able to).
The past participle of devoir is '{dû}': elle a dû.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: elle a dû (she had to).
That's imparfait! Use passé composé: elle a dû (she had to).
The past participle of dire is '{dit}': j'ai dit.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: j'ai dit (I said).
That's imparfait! Use passé composé: j'ai dit (I said yes).
The past participle of prendre is '{pris}': nous avons pris.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: nous avons pris (we took).
That's imparfait! Use passé composé: nous avons pris (we took).

items.gloss: Did you put my coat somewhere?

mistakes.feedback: The past participle of mettre is '{mis}': vous avez mis.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: vous avez mis (you put).
The past participle of comprendre is '{compris}': ils ont compris.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: ils ont compris (they understood).
'Pris' is for prendre (took)! Use '{compris}' for comprendre (understood).
The past participle of apprendre is '{appris}': on a appris.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: on a appris (we learned).
'Pris' is for prendre (took)! Use '{appris}' for apprendre (learned).

items.gloss: I couldn't go / I wasn't able to go

mistakes.feedback: The past participle of pouvoir is '{pu}': je n'ai pas pu.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: je n'ai pas pu aller.
The past participle of vouloir is '{voulu}': tu n'as pas voulu.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: tu n'as pas voulu venir?
The past participle of devoir is '{dû}': elle a dû.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: elle a dû partir.
The past participle of dire is '{dit}': tu as dit.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: tu as dit (you said).

items.gloss: I had a coffee / I took a coffee

mistakes.feedback: The past participle of prendre is '{pris}': j'ai pris.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: j'ai pris (I had/took).

items.text: Nous ___ nos livres sur la table
items.gloss: We put our books on the table

mistakes.feedback: The past participle of mettre is '{mis}': nous avons mis.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: nous avons mis (we put).
The past participle of comprendre is '{compris}': vous avez compris.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: vous avez compris (you understood).
The past participle of apprendre is '{appris}': ils ont appris.
That's present tense! Use passé composé: ils ont appris (they learned).

items.gloss: We said no / One said no

mistakes.feedback: The past participle of dire is '{dit}': on a dit.
You need the auxiliary 'a'! It's '{on a dit non}', not just '{dit non}'.

items.text: J'___ aller au cinéma mais je n'ai pas eu le temps
items.gloss: I wanted to go to the cinema but I didn't have time

mistakes.feedback: The past participle of vouloir is '{voulu}': j'ai voulu aller.
That's imparfait! Use passé composé: j'ai voulu (I wanted).
